<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Venedaemon (Pact Daemon)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2892)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Those killed by magic or killed in the pursuit of magic can arise as venedaemons. Although among the weaker daemons, these robed figures can often be seen serving as researchers or clerks throughout the plane. Even within the mortal [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26), scholars barter souls or arcane knowledge with venedaemons for their secrets and assistance.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 20

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Venedaemon.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 5">[Venedaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2892)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Daemon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=568" />
<trait label="Fiend" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=600" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 73

**Perception** +12; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), smell magic ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet

**Languages**
[Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Daemonic](/Languages.aspx?ID=31), [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Requian](/Languages.aspx?ID=34); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +13, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +16, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +12, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +14, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +13, [Scribing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +14

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +4

**Con** +2

**Int** +5

**Wis** +3

**Cha** +3
</row>

**Smell Magic** A venedaemon is aware of magical items and active spells as an imprecise sense. The subtle differences in these scents reveal the tradition and traits of the magic.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 21 

**Fort** +9 

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +14 

+1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 75

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects

**Weaknesses**
[holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) 5

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tentacle +13 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 2d6+5 bludgeoning

**Arcane Spontaneous Spells** DC 22
- **Cantrips (3rd)**
[Electric Arc](/Spells.aspx?ID=97), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280), [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286), [Telekinetic Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715), [Void Warp](/Spells.aspx?ID=1745)
- **1st**
[Enfeeble](/Spells.aspx?ID=1513), [Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), [Force Barrage](/Spells.aspx?ID=1536), [Illusory Disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=159) (4 slots)
- **2nd**
[Blazing Bolt](/Spells.aspx?ID=1450), [Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164), [Noise Blast](/Spells.aspx?ID=1616) (4 slots)
- **3rd**
[Fireball](/Spells.aspx?ID=119), [Levitate](/Spells.aspx?ID=170), [Paralyze](/Spells.aspx?ID=213) (3 slots)

**Divine Innate Spells** DC 22
- **4th**
[Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724)

**Residual Force** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) **Requirements** The venedaemon's most recent action was to cast a spell; **Effect** Fading runes cling to the venedaemon's tentacles. The venedaemon makes a tentacle Strike that has a reach of 20 feet and deals 2d4 additional force damage.

**Soul Spell**   If a venedaemon ingest a soul gem from a [cacodaemon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2891), they can recover an expended spell slot instead of gaining fast healing. The spell slot's rank can be no higher than half the level of the creature whose soul was consumed, rounded up.

**Twisted Whispers** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The venedaemon whispers to a creature within 15 feet, which must succeed at a DC 22 Will save or be [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) for 1 minute (or stupefied 3 on a critical failure). Regardless of the results of the save, the creature is immune to Twisted Whispers for 24 hours.

</column>
